sources.title: Literature Meets Data: A Synergistic Approach to Hypothesis Generation
sources.actual_reading: Cached original text lines 38-49 (sections 2.2/2.3: UCB-inspired reward, wrong-example pool, iterative hypothesis refinement/union); lines 97-120 include section 7 limitations. Not a full-paper new reading.
sources.use: Motivates explicit feedback-driven hypothesis proposal under limited tools; M5 uses retrospective residual and task-action disagreement, not its classifier reward or literature retrieval pipeline.
limitations: Paper tasks are natural-language classification; no dynamic EM field or UAV optimization evidence.
Paper notes limited literature corpus, non-exhaustive tuning and small human study; subjective hypothesis selection limits attribution.
M5 regions, 4dB rule, source birth weights and budgets are project choices, not guarantees from this paper.
M5 known tail points are already public development feedback, not independent future validation; no new RAG or training.
